name: Jesus
note: From Nazareth in Galilee. Matthew presents him as the Messiah from David's line, and as "God with us."

name: Mary
note: Engaged to Joseph when she is found to be pregnant. Matthew tells the birth story from Joseph's side.

name: Joseph
note: Mary's husband, from David's line. Guided by dreams, he protects the child and his mother.

name: Herod the Great
note: Rome's client king over Judea. A great builder, and ruthless toward anyone who threatened his throne.

name: The magi
note: Visitors from the east who read the stars and come to honor a newborn king. Matthew doesn't say how many there were.

name: Archelaus
note: Herod's son who ruled Judea after him, harshly enough that Rome later removed him.

name: John the Baptist
note: A prophet in the wilderness who calls people to repent and baptizes them in the Jordan.

name: Scribes, Pharisees, and Sadducees
note: Leading groups in Judaism. Scribes were experts in the law; Pharisees taught careful keeping of it; Sadducees were tied to the priests and the temple.

name: The devil
note: The tempter, who tests Jesus in the wilderness.

name: Simon Peter
note: A fisherman from Galilee, the first disciple called and the most prominent of the twelve.

name: Andrew
note: Peter's brother, also a fisherman.

name: James
note: Son of Zebedee, called with his brother John from their father's boat.

name: John
note: Son of Zebedee and brother of James.

name: Tamar, Rahab, Ruth, and "Uriah's wife"
note: Four women named in Jesus' family line, each with an unusual story. Ruth is the Ruth whose book we studied.

name: The disciples
note: Jesus' followers, starting with the four fishermen. Later, the twelve.

name: The crowds
note: Ordinary people from Galilee, Judea, and beyond who follow Jesus to listen and be healed.

name: Solomon
note: David's son, Israel's wealthiest and wisest king.

name: A man with a skin disease
note: Shut out by the purity laws until a priest declared him clean.

name: The centurion
note: A Gentile officer stationed in or near Capernaum.

name: Peter's mother-in-law
note: She lived in Peter's house in Capernaum.

name: Two men from the tombs
note: Possessed by demons, living among the dead in Gentile territory.

name: A paralyzed man
note: Brought to Jesus on a mat by his friends.

name: A woman who had bled for twelve years
note: Unclean under the law for all that time.

name: A synagogue leader
note: Unnamed in Matthew; Mark and Luke call him Jairus.

name: Matthew
note: A tax collector in Capernaum who becomes one of the twelve.

name: The twelve apostles
note: Peter, Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot.

name: Simon the Zealot
note: One of the twelve. His name may point to zeal for the law or resistance to Rome.

name: Judas Iscariot
note: One of the twelve, who later betrays Jesus.

name: Thomas
note: One of the twelve.

name: Philip
note: One of the twelve.

name: Bartholomew
note: One of the twelve.

name: James son of Alphaeus
note: One of the twelve.

name: Thaddaeus
note: One of the twelve.

name: John's disciples
note: Followers of John the Baptist who kept his practices, such as fasting.

name: A man with a withered hand
note: Healed in a synagogue on the Sabbath.

name: Jesus' mother and brothers
note: His mother Mary and his brothers, named in 13:55 as James, Joses, Simon, and Judas, with sisters not named.

name: The people of Nazareth
note: Jesus' neighbors and relatives, who knew him as a craftsman's son.

name: Herod Antipas
note: A son of Herod the Great, appointed by Rome as tetrarch of Galilee and Perea. Matthew first calls him tetrarch, then king.

name: Herodias
note: Antipas's wife, who had been married to his half-brother Philip and was also his niece.

name: Herodias's daughter
note: Unnamed in Matthew; the historian Josephus calls her Salome.

name: The Canaanite woman
note: A Gentile mother from the region of Tyre and Sidon, whose daughter is tormented by a demon.

name: Elijah
note: A prophet of Israel, taken up to heaven, expected by many to return before the Lord's day.

name: Moses
note: The lawgiver who led Israel out of Egypt and met God on Mount Sinai.

name: A boy with seizures and his father
note: Unnamed in Matthew; the father kneels and begs for mercy.

name: The temple-tax collectors
note: Men in Capernaum who collected the annual half-shekel for the temple.

name: A child
note: Unnamed in Matthew. Jesus calls the child over and sets the child among the disciples.
